text: Functions c4e return c4e_tbl objects: tibbles one extra attribute, metadata, recording context data. context includes key column, variable unit, time step, date range CRS. also holds registry describing every indicator column, threshold, direction, percentile spell length. Later steps pipeline read defaults , value given typed . c4e_tbl behaves like tibble. Row column verbs (mutate(), filter(), select(), rename(), joins, bind_rows(), [, grouped operations) keep metadata. Dropping column removes registry, renaming column renames registry. Verbs change rows mean, summarise() tidyr::pivot_longer(), return plain tibble. package functions summarise rebuild metadata . stacking tables, dplyr::bind_rows() keeps metadata first table . vctrs::vec_rbind() merges metadata . join indicator tables side side, use bind_indicators(). c4e_meta() returns metadata, one field . is_c4e_tbl() tests class. update_meta() sets clears fields. plain data frame creates c4e_tbl. tibble::as_tibble() removes class metadata.
